in_arabic.name: ريزان
in_arabic.meaning: ريزان يعني الثبات و الاستقرار و القوة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم ريزان مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ر-ز-ن' والذي يعني الثبات و الاستقرار. و يدل على القوة و الصبر. و قد ورد هذا الجذر في القرآن الكريم في سورة الحجر آية ٧٨ 'وَأَثْبَتْنَاهُ بِكَلِمَةٍ مِن رَبِّهِ' حيث تشير إلى الثبات و الاستقرار. و يعتبر اسم ريزان من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني جميلة و قيمة روحية عالية في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: رضوان

data.cultural_impact: The name Rizaan holds a significant cultural impact in the Islamic world as it reflects a person's character and values. The name is derived from the Arabic root "rz," which means contentment or satisfaction. In Islamic culture, contentment and satisfaction are highly valued virtues as they are believed to lead to inner peace and happiness. The name Rizaan represents an individual who possesses these qualities and strives to find contentment in all aspects of life, including in their relationships, material possessions, and spiritual beliefs.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Rizaan holds a deep significance as it is a constant reminder of the importance of finding contentment and satisfaction in Allah (God). The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) taught that true happiness and peace come from pleasing Allah and seeking His pleasure above all else. The name Rizaan encourages its bearer to focus on the eternal rewards of pleasing Allah and finding inner peace and tranquility through faith and obedience to His commands. Thus, the name Rizaan has a spiritual significance in the Islamic tradition as it inspires individuals to strive for a closer relationship with Allah and find ultimate satisfaction in Him.
